glossary_clean.name: ALLIANCE SPACE
glossary_clean.desc: Represents every quadrant of the galaxy under alliance control. Systems in the alliance control all have similar laws and citizen rights. This is what most people would call the civilized world.

glossary_clean.name: AMMO
glossary_clean.desc: The quantity and type of ammo the weapon has in its magazine. Energy weapons tend to have a power cell giving X shots before it is depleted and automatically begins recharging (cooldown period). Ammunition is universal and comes in 3 sizes small S, medium M and large L.

glossary_clean.name: LIVING
glossary_clean.desc: Device automatically recovers 1 SYSTEM or NANITE per MAINTENANCE (players choice).

glossary_clean.name: ATTRIBUTE BONUS
glossary_clean.desc: When rolling a skill with an associated positive attribute you can reroll a number of failures equal to that attribute. In the case of a negative attribute you must reroll a number of successes.

glossary_clean.name: AVAILABILITY
glossary_clean.desc: Availability governs the rarity of certain items. Players can search for vendors, ask contacts or just ask around to see if they can find the required item.

glossary_clean.name: BASIC ATTACK
glossary_clean.desc: A basic attack is an attack that cannot be modified with talents, modifiers or outside help. You perform a skill check and apply the unmodified results.

glossary_clean.name: BASIC DATACOMS
glossary_clean.desc: Your basic multi use communication device. Basic datacoms can be part of a network but cannot create one.

glossary_clean.name: BATTLECRUISERS
glossary_clean.desc: A battlecruiser is designed to be fast like a cruiser but with multiple turrets or giant guns. Battlecruisers are the main ships on the frontline of a war and often serve as bases of operations in a sector. Typical sizes is around 400m min with a crew of around 25. Max passengers is around 500.

glossary_clean.name: BLEEDING
glossary_clean.desc: Bleeding causes a character to lose 1 HEALTH every maintenance phase. (Recover or Medicine DC 1 to recover)

glossary_clean.name: BREACHED
glossary_clean.desc: When BREACHED your DEFENSE is reduced by a one category (No effect if [NONE]) until the next maintenance phase.

glossary_clean.name: BROKEN
glossary_clean.desc: Broken cause a LARGE penalty to the following attributes: MENTAL, WITS, SOCIAL and WILLPOWER

glossary_clean.name: BUNKER
glossary_clean.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when not moving. (Bonus applies during maintenance phase after a full round of no movement).

glossary_clean.name: BURST FIRE
glossary_clean.desc: Weapons with a B in the R.O.F category can perform a BURST FIRE action. This is a STANDARD attack but the roll and damage is now lucky at the cost of 3 ammo

glossary_clean.name: CARRIERS
glossary_clean.desc: A carrier is a nova cruiser that is missing the main gun battery and most of the armor. If a carrier is getting close enough to need armor, the captain and/or admiral needs to be fired. They are designed to carry and deliver payloads be it cargo, passengers, fighters, missiles etc.  Typical size starts at  1400m+ length with a crew of 75 and around 2000 passengers.

glossary_clean.name: CARRY
glossary_clean.desc: Replaced by lightweight

glossary_clean.name: EFFICIENT
glossary_clean.desc: Weapon only consumes 1 AMMO per attack regardless of actions (FULL AUTO, BURST etc.)

glossary_clean.name: CLOAK
glossary_clean.desc: Provides passive CONCEALMENT 3 type I and II. Passive concealment is 6 when not moving for a round.

glossary_clean.name: CLONE SICKNESS
glossary_clean.desc: Anyone that has been cloned will suffer from the SICK ailment. This ailment cannot be removed by a RECOVER, instead it lasts until you gain 25 exp (or 2 weeks for anyone that cannot gain XP).

glossary_clean.name: COMPLEX ACTION
glossary_clean.desc: A COMPLEX action is achieved by sacrificing either a QUICK action or MOVE action to enhance your STANDARD action, turning it into a COMPLEX action.

glossary_clean.name: COMPROMISED
glossary_clean.desc: COMPROMISED is a LIGHT TRAUMA for objects and machines. An ITEM that is COMPROMISED loses access to EXTERNAL components

glossary_clean.name: CORONTHIA
glossary_clean.desc: Super dense fuel that has restricted use in all alliance atmospheres. It has an amazing power potential but an equal instability potential rending it very dangerous for use. Fusion cores have replaced more coronthia engines but some remain.

glossary_clean.name: CORVETTES
glossary_clean.desc: Corvettes are a patrol craft, designed to be lethal to civilian shipping and most pirates, but really more policeoriented than military. Average size is around 50m with typical crews of around 5 and can carry up to 25 passengers.

glossary_clean.name: DEFLECTOR
glossary_clean.desc: Forcefield can only be used when you succeed a PARRY against ranged or melee attacks. This FORCEFIELD never needs to RECHARGE and only counts as your DEFENSE option if you succeed your PARRY.

glossary_clean.name: COVER
glossary_clean.desc: When next to object and structures, targets are considered to be using them as cover (unless stated otherwise). Attackers get the option to try to avoid hitting the cover, giving the attacker a skill check penalty or try to go through the cover which gives the defender bonus defense.

glossary_clean.name: COVER FIRE
glossary_clean.desc: As a COMPLEX action you can perform a COVER FIRE action. Designate 3 (burst fire) or 9 (full auto) squares meters in weapon range as cover fire area (must be contiguous). Then roll your attack as normal; anyone you hit gains the SUPPRESSED AILMENT. If you perform any other actions others than cover fire of if the target leaves the area the SUPPRESSED ailment is removed.

glossary_clean.name: CPU
glossary_clean.desc: How many ROUTINES, PROGRAMS, GADGETS or ACTIONS can this device handle every round. ROUTINES only consume CPU when active.

glossary_clean.name: CRIPPLED
glossary_clean.desc: CRIPPLED is a SEVERE TRAUMA for objects and machines. An ITEM that is CRIPPLED loses access to EXTERNAL and INTERNAL components.

glossary_clean.name: CRITICAL AILMENTS
glossary_clean.desc: When a target loses HEALTH or MORALE from an attack that was either a CRITICAL HIT or has caused a TRAUMA, the target also suffers from a CRITICAL AILMENT. Effect is the critical ailment depends on the damage type that caused it (see critical ailment table below)

glossary_clean.name: CRITICAL DAMAGE
glossary_clean.desc: Deal maximum damage (No dmg roll required), if the target suffers any damage from the attack that caused the hit they also gain a CRITICAL AILMENT. To score a critical hit a player must roll a natural 10 on their luck dice. To qualify as a critical hit the hit must have been a valid hit in the first place.

glossary_clean.name: CRITICAL SUCCESS
glossary_clean.desc: Grants the maximum number of success possible (replace the result of your skill roll). To achieve a critical success roll a player must roll a natural/modified 10 on their luck dice.

glossary_clean.name: CROUCHED
glossary_clean.desc: Grants LIGHT COVER Vs ranged attacks. All movement is treated as being in difficult terrain. Your DEFENSE Vs MELEE has a SMALL penalty

glossary_clean.name: CRUISERS
glossary_clean.desc: Cruisers are designed to run away from whatever it can’t kill and kill anything it can’t run away from. They are large enough to operate independently in or out of deep space. Some can also have small ship bays. Typical size is around 200m length with crews ranging from 8 to 20. Specifically designed cruisers can carry up to 200 passengers.

glossary_clean.name: DAMAGE
glossary_clean.desc: Damage determines the amount of damage a weapon does once a hit has passed defenses.

glossary_clean.name: HACKPROOF
glossary_clean.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against TECH attacks.

glossary_clean.name: DARK SPACE
glossary_clean.desc: Represents every mapped quadrant outside the reach of the alliance. Every system in the dark space has their own laws and customs. This is also what people call the frontier worlds.

glossary_clean.name: DAZE
glossary_clean.desc: Daze = can only perform one action this round and cannot use quick action

glossary_clean.name: DC
glossary_clean.desc: Difficulty is the target number of successes required to succeed at a task.

glossary_clean.name: DEEP SPACE
glossary_clean.desc: Unexplored area of space, very few venture in those areas, few even return. What is truly out there no one really knows.

glossary_clean.name: DEFEND
glossary_clean.desc: If you win initiative, you can actively defend against an attack or event. The skill or method used to defend is up to the player as long as it is relevant(GM approval). On success you add the result of the skill to your DEFENSE roll. If you fail initiative, you were too slow.

glossary_clean.name: DEFLECT
glossary_clean.desc: Deflect gets added to your DEFENSE (along cover and other modifiers) to counter POWER and determine how much damage penetrates or is negated by the armor. A higher value will reduce damage while a lower value will hinder your ability to SOAK damage properly.

glossary_clean.name: DESTROYED
glossary_clean.desc: Destroyed happens when you lose more than 2x your HEALTH, HULL, MORALE or SYSTEM. Anything suffering a destroyed result is obliterated beyond any recovery.

glossary_clean.name: DEVICE
glossary_clean.desc: A device is a single function tool that can connect to a node (Forcefield,  most drones, guns, etc.). Unless specified devices have an INTEGRITY of 1. You do not hack devices directly, you hack their NODE

glossary_clean.name: DIFFICULT TERRAIN
glossary_clean.desc: Environment not suitable for proper movement cost double movement per square (1m) special movement like stealth, climbing, swimming, no gravity have the same effect. Special movement through difficult terrain cost triple movement.

glossary_clean.name: DISCRETE
glossary_clean.desc: You hardly register on electronic surveillance. You now always have passive concealment of 5 vs AI and Electronics.

glossary_clean.name: DOMAIN
glossary_clean.desc: Magic is divised in DOMAINS, each of them regroups SPIRITS, SPELLS, BARRIERS and is associated with it's appropriate SKILL.

glossary_clean.name: DUAL WEAPONS
glossary_clean.desc: Need one handed weapons, when attacking you repeat your action with a secondary weapon and a SMALL penalty. Actions done through DW require the same target and actions. Reloading is per weapon still.

glossary_clean.name: DUELIST
glossary_clean.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against MELEE attacks.

glossary_clean.name: DURABILITY
glossary_clean.desc: Replaces HEALTH for nonliving things like vehicles, ships, drones, buildings, etc

glossary_clean.name: DYING
glossary_clean.desc: If you lose all your health, morale or suffer too many traumas you gain the DYING status. Dying characters lose consciousness and will die in 3 rounds unless someone stabilizes you  (Medicine DC 5 or Leadership DC5).

glossary_clean.name: EMERGENCY
glossary_clean.desc: Once per SCENE you can instantly recharge this FORCEFIELD as a FREE action.

glossary_clean.name: ENERGY
glossary_clean.desc: EXPOSURE : Gain damage vulnerability 1 to all (Cumulative if reapplied). Extreme heat, cold or electric discharges causing burns or tissue damage.

glossary_clean.name: EXPERTISE
glossary_clean.desc: Expertise represents the ease of use of an item. Expertise only applies when making COMPLEX actions unless the value is negative, then it applies on all actions. EXPERTISE adds 1 DAMAGE per extra success over your DIFFICULTY to hit up to the maximum EXPERTISE rating of the weapon. Negative expertise increases the DC of all skill rolls by X.

glossary_clean.name: FIGHTERS
glossary_clean.desc: Fighters are short range small fixed weapon spaceships usually used in warfare. They range from 1525m and have a small crews of 13 people.

glossary_clean.name: FIXED WEAPONS
glossary_clean.desc: Weapons that are fixed are always facing where the ship is facing and thus cannot hit a target if the GUNNER has a ROLE DISADVANTAGE (ship is facing the wrong way).

glossary_clean.name: FLANKED
glossary_clean.desc: When you have two or more enemies at opposite sides of you are considered FLANKED. While FLANKED you are consided BREACHED.

glossary_clean.name: FOCUS
glossary_clean.desc: In a challenge round, you can use your QUICK action to FOCUS. While focussed you gain a SMALL bonus to your next action.

glossary_clean.name: FORCE
glossary_clean.desc: DAZED : You cannot perform quick actions. (STUNNED if reapplied). Explosives, concussive force and area crushing damage falls under this category

glossary_clean.name: FORCEFIELD / SHIELDS
glossary_clean.desc: When damage exceeds the value of a shield or forcefield you ignore the rest of the hit no matter how much damage is left. (ie: shield gating).

glossary_clean.name: FRIGATES
glossary_clean.desc: Frigates are a corvette with cruiserclass weapons. A frigate is a ship designed to be tougher than any pirate, and faster than any cruiser. They can handle short range missions but remain limited in operational range. Average size is around 100m with typical crews of around 10 people and can carry up to 50 passengers.

glossary_clean.name: FULL AUTO
glossary_clean.desc: Weapons with a F in the R.O.F category can perform a FULL AUTO action. Full auto is always COMPLEX action. On a FULL AUTO action your EXPERTISE result counts as additional hits instead of additional damage. You can distribute the hits among any targets within X (EXPERTISE) meters of the initial target.

glossary_clean.name: FULL DATACOMS
glossary_clean.desc: An advanced datacom that functions like a basic datacom but more powerful and can act as a HOST NODE to form a NETWORK

glossary_clean.name: GADGET
glossary_clean.desc: A set of instructions for your DATACOM to build temporary constructs that have various effects. Unless specified using a GADGET is a standard action and last a SCENE unless specified.

glossary_clean.name: GALACTIC QUADRANT
glossary_clean.desc: The standard unit of measurement for a sector of the known universe. A star system is usually a single quadrant.

glossary_clean.name: GOOD COVER
glossary_clean.desc: LARGE PENALTY or HIGH to EXTREME DEFENSE | Reinforced items, metal plates, heavy concrete, large stone items, Large appliances, solid furniture, a car, brick or concrete walls, large trees etc.

glossary_clean.name: GRAVE WOUND
glossary_clean.desc: Grave wounds cause a SMALL penalty to the following attributes: PHYSICAL, ENDURANCE, ACUITY and SPEED.

glossary_clean.name: HARDENED
glossary_clean.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against PHYSICAL attacks.

glossary_clean.name: HEALING
glossary_clean.desc: During MAINTENANCE you can spend any number of NANITES, or personal CHI to recover an equal amount of HEALTH or MORALE

glossary_clean.name: INSULATING
glossary_clean.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against ENERGY attacks.

glossary_clean.name: MEDIUM ARMOR
glossary_clean.desc: Provide good protection and counts as a MEDIUM item for encumbrance. Requires 2 rounds to put on or remove.

glossary_clean.name: INDESTRUCTIBLE
glossary_clean.desc: This defense cannot be BREACHED.

glossary_clean.name: INNOCULATION
glossary_clean.desc: Device protects against non lethal environmental hazards. Gain a LARGE bonus to skills rolls against lethal environmental hazards and ailments.

glossary_clean.name: INSTANT DETONATION
glossary_clean.desc: You can take a SMALL penality to your DEXTERITY roll to prevents targets from performing any actions before detonation.

glossary_clean.name: INTEGRITY
glossary_clean.desc: How much MORALE damage you can SOAK. Stacks with user's WILLPOWER defensive attribute

glossary_clean.name: JUMP DRIVE
glossary_clean.desc: A jump drive is a device for ships designed for long distance travel. Jumping takes time and is in no way instant but cuts down travel times massively.

glossary_clean.name: KRAVEN
glossary_clean.desc: Giant insect like race that first appeared in the ancient nerulian empire. Within days of their appearance the nerulian empire was obliterated and has remained since. No living being has ever been able to communicate with the Kravens.

glossary_clean.name: KRAVEN SPACE
glossary_clean.desc: A giant area of the galaxy that used to be the nerulian empire is now just known as Kraven space. No nerulian has any claims left in the area.

glossary_clean.name: LARGE BONUS
glossary_clean.desc: Increase total successes of a roll by 3

glossary_clean.name: LARGE PENALTY
glossary_clean.desc: Decrease total successes of a roll by 3 (min 0)

glossary_clean.name: LEADERSHIP
glossary_clean.desc: Leadership can heal one point of morale. DC of the check is equal to the target's missing MORALE

glossary_clean.name: LEGALITY
glossary_clean.desc: Legality class determines whether it is legal or not to carry such an item under the alliance law. Outside of the alliance, laws are usually localized.

glossary_clean.name: LIGHT ARMOR
glossary_clean.desc: Provide basic protection and counts as a SMALL item for encumbrance. Requires 1 rounds to put on or remove.

glossary_clean.name: BAD COVER
glossary_clean.desc: SMALL PENALTY or LOW to MEDIUM DEFENSE | Small appliances, a trashcan, small trees, lamppost, a car door, coffee table, plaster walls etc.

glossary_clean.name: LOCAL NODE
glossary_clean.desc: A datacom, server or device which you are directly using by being physically connected to. Being physically connected automatically bypass the NETWORK and you instead deals with the local device defenses.

glossary_clean.name: LOCKON
glossary_clean.desc: While under the effect of lockon a target cannot stealth and will always grant line of sight (cover still applies).

glossary_clean.name: SPIRITPROOF
glossary_clean.desc: Always get maximum SOAK rolls when defending against SPIRITUAL attacks.

glossary_clean.name: MASTERWORK
glossary_clean.desc: Critical hits have no additional effects. Masterwork has no effect if the wearer is BREACHED.

glossary_clean.name: MAX WEIGHT
glossary_clean.desc: Players can carry a limited number of objects but they are also limited by WEIGHT. MAX WEIGHT is = 50 KG Modified by Physique times 5KG |  Lift = 5 time your total carry | Push or drag =  10 times your carry

glossary_clean.name: MEMORY
glossary_clean.desc: Total data capacity your device can hold. Your ROUTINES, PROGRAMS and TOOLS reduce this capacity.

glossary_clean.name: ABSOLUTION
glossary_clean.desc: You get maximum SOAK when a critical faillure results in a SOAK roll. (From a DEFENSE check or other checks)

glossary_clean.name: MORTAL WOUND
glossary_clean.desc: Mortal wounds cause a LARGE penalty to the following attributes: PHYSICAL, ENDURANCE, ACUITY and SPEED.

glossary_clean.name: MOVEMENT
glossary_clean.desc: Move up to 5m in a round. You can also use a STANDARD action to move allowing for an additional movement action. If your previous action was a move you can instead RUN (see description). You can also change stance (prone, crouch) this counts as moving 1 meter.

glossary_clean.name: MOVEMENT (in combat)
glossary_clean.desc: During a round where you have moved, you gain a SMALL BONUS to your defense VS any attacks performed against you. Because you moved you also have a SMALL penalty to all skill checks.

glossary_clean.name: NANITES
glossary_clean.desc: NANITES are a special ressources that powers nanomachines and enable and enables your DATACOM to form or interact with physical objects in the real world. NANITES recharge after a SCENE.

glossary_clean.name: NANOBOTS
glossary_clean.desc: During maintenance phase you can spend any number of NANITES to reroll failed AILMENTS saves.

glossary_clean.name: NEBULA
glossary_clean.desc: Sectors within a NEBULA experience all sorts of anomalies. Any captain should steer well away from those areas as you never know which system will stop working on your ship.

glossary_clean.name: NEMANI RIFT
glossary_clean.desc: A giant nebula that spans from the ASH system all the way into Kraven space. For some reason Kravens cannot seems to traverse that area. Any exploration of the area is forbidden due to the lethal nature of the area.

glossary_clean.name: NETWORK
glossary_clean.desc: Allows private sharing of anything in memory to any connected NODES within range. Any REMOTE NODE attacks against a NETWORK is done against the NETWORK CONTROLLER.

glossary_clean.name: NODE
glossary_clean.desc: A node is a intelligentdevice that exists within a network or by itself and that has a FIREWALL and can run ROUTINES or have devices connect to it. (Datacom, intelligent devices, advanced drones, etc.)

glossary_clean.name: NOVA
glossary_clean.desc: Once per SCENE as a FREE action, when this forcefield breaks you can chose to deal 2D + 4 [HIGH] STUN PHYSICAL damage to everyone in a 2m radius. Targets hit by this attack are pushed back 2m.

glossary_clean.name: NOVA CRUISERS
glossary_clean.desc: A nova cruiser is a battlecruiser with enough armor to survive being hit by another battlecruiser. They are gigantic structures that resemble ships but who's main function is to provide the anchor for a fleet. Typical size is 5km length with a crew of 100+ and up to 10k passengers.

glossary_clean.name: OPERATION
glossary_clean.desc: Modifies existing function of an item.

glossary_clean.name: ORDONNANCE
glossary_clean.desc: Ordonnance weapons are ship weapons that also require ammunition. If not paired with an ammo bay the weapon has enough munitions to fire until it needs to reload.

glossary_clean.name: PHASE
glossary_clean.desc: Phase you out of reality when attacked. Gain a 1 in 10 chance of negating any attack.

glossary_clean.name: PHYSICAL
glossary_clean.desc: BLEED : Lose 1 HEALTH per maintenance phase. (Cummulative if reapplied). Damage caused by physicaly hitting a target with another material object (bullets, melee weapons, fists). Bullets, Needles and Melee damage generally falls into this category

glossary_clean.name: POWER
glossary_clean.desc: Power determines the relative strength of the weapon and is a direct counter to DEFENSE. Every point of power above DEFENSE will deny SOAK and under will reduce damage by the same amount.

glossary_clean.name: HEAVY ARMOR
glossary_clean.desc: Provide excellent protection and counts as a LARGE item for encumbrance. Requires 3 rounds to put on or remove.

glossary_clean.name: PRECISION HIT
glossary_clean.desc: You can take a SMALL penalty to a COMPLEX attack to target a specific location or object. (Can be used to hit armor weak spots, armor is treated as BREACHED for that hit but requires you to identify the armor type first via tactics)

glossary_clean.name: PROGRAM
glossary_clean.desc: A program is something you can use as a standard action to replace basic hacking action. Programs only cost MEMORY.

glossary_clean.name: PRONE
glossary_clean.desc: Grants GOOD COVER vs ranged attacks. Your maximum movement is 2. Your DEFENSE Vs MELEE has a LARGE penalty.

glossary_clean.name: QUICK ACTION
glossary_clean.desc: Quick actions can be performed at any point during the round (including enemy turn). If you call a QUICK action during someone else's turn you must win initiative. (See INTERUPTS and REACTIONS)

glossary_clean.name: QUICK ATTACK
glossary_clean.desc: Any power, weapon or item that has the QUICK keyword can be used to perform a BASIC ATTACK as a QUICK ACTION.

glossary_clean.name: RANGE
glossary_clean.desc: Datacoms have a default range of melee, 100m, 1000m (Skill penalties are  0/1/3). In Melee range you are considered connected directly.

glossary_clean.name: RECOVER
glossary_clean.desc: During maintenance you can roll 1D for every ailment you are suffering from. On a 6+ you recover, on a failure the ailment continues.

glossary_clean.name: REGEN
glossary_clean.desc: When SOAK run out a forcefield is rendered innactive. To recharge a forcefield, you must spend the time under "Regen" not being shot at. When that condition is true your forcefield returns during the next maintenance phase.

glossary_clean.name: REMOTE NODE
glossary_clean.desc: A datacom, server or network in range of your datacom which you have no physical connection to. Defense is always set by network and HACKING actions when on a remote NODE can suffer a penalty based on the range.

glossary_clean.name: RESISTANT
glossary_clean.desc: Reduce damage by X of the type specified.

glossary_clean.name: RESSOURCE UNITS
glossary_clean.desc: Standardized measure of the resources required to repair things aboard a ship. One resource unit can repair one point of shield, hull or system.

glossary_clean.name: REST
glossary_clean.desc: Resting for a period of 10 hours in a non threatening safe area will recover your ENDURANCE in HEALTH and WILLPOWER in MORALE.

glossary_clean.name: SMUGGLER
glossary_clean.desc: Can hide up to a small object. Provides passive concealment of 5 or a LARGE bonus to an active Concealment roll.

glossary_clean.name: ROLE ADVANTAGE
glossary_clean.desc: You grant your skill roll result as a bonus to the next person's job in the job order.

glossary_clean.name: ROLE DISAVANTAGE
glossary_clean.desc: You add your skill roll result as a penalty to the next person's job in the job order.

glossary_clean.name: ROUTINE
glossary_clean.desc: A set of instructions that can run on a datacom. ROUTINES consume CPU to stay active and provides passive benefits to anyone connected to the network.

glossary_clean.name: RUN
glossary_clean.desc: If your last action was a move action you can replace your MOVE with a RUN action. RUN double your movement speed. If you stop at any point, you must MOVE again before running again.

glossary_clean.name: RUN (in combat)
glossary_clean.desc: When running, increase the move DEFENSE bonus to LARGE and the move SKILL check penalty to LARGE.

glossary_clean.name: SANITY TRESHOLD
glossary_clean.desc: When you suffer morale damage from an attack that exceeds your willpower modifier, you gain the shaken status ailment or broken status if you were already shaken.

glossary_clean.name: SCRAPPED
glossary_clean.desc: Scrapped indicates that an object or item stops functioning completely. Nothing works anymore, item will have to be repaired before it can be used again.

glossary_clean.name: SERVOS
glossary_clean.desc: Your PHYSICAL attribute for MIGHT checks is 10. Device now counts as ELECTRONIC Vs EMP.

glossary_clean.name: SHAKEN
glossary_clean.desc: Shaken cause a SMALL penalty to the following attributes: MENTAL, WITS, SOCIAL and WILLPOWER.

glossary_clean.name: SHIFT
glossary_clean.desc: You can use a QUICK action to move up to 1m, change your stance (crouch, stand, prone). A SHIFT does not cause opportunity attacks when used to move out of the reach of a target.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP AVAILABLE POWER
glossary_clean.desc: Spaceships need power for their various components, if there's a surplus it will be listed as available power. This can be used for various things like weapons, shields or various systems.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP CARGO
glossary_clean.desc: The value on your ship's cargo indicates how many units of cargo you can fit in that area. One unit of ship cargo is equal to one HUGE item.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP CLASS
glossary_clean.desc: The class of a ship determines which category it belongs to: Ship classes from smallest to largest are Drones, Fighters, Corvettes, Frigates, Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Carriers and Nova Cruisers.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP COMBAT RANGE
glossary_clean.desc: The combat range is your ship's weapon range, weapons that exceed this range will have to shoot blind.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP COMMAND
glossary_clean.desc: The command rating of a ship indicates how well designed it is for a leader to direct its crew. See COMMAND section under SPACE rules for details

glossary_clean.name: SHIP COMPONENTS
glossary_clean.desc: The ship component count indicate how much space you have on a given design to add new areas and components.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP CORE COMPONENTS
glossary_clean.desc: The core of a ship is the most protected area of the ship and any components housed in that area will keep functioning until the ship is SCRAPPED.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP DRONES
glossary_clean.desc: Drones are short range crewless single task spaceships. They range from 510 meters and while some can handle cargo none of them can handle living things.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP ECM
glossary_clean.desc: ECM stands for electronic counter measures and the value indicates your ship's SYSTEM damage threshold. Any system damage exceeding this value in a single hit will cause a TRAUMA.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP ENGINEERING
glossary_clean.desc: The engineering rating of a ship indicates how much RESSOURCE UNITS it can generate and how skilled an engineer must be to operate it. See ENGINEERING section under SPACE rules for details.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP FUEL
glossary_clean.desc: Most ships operate using fusion drives which have a lifetime supply of fuel, some ships however, run on CORONTHIA a super dense fuel that produce an immense amount of power but requires refuelling.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP GRAVITY
glossary_clean.desc: Ships have artificial gravity as long as they have power movement inside is normal. Gravity is part of the life support component. If life support is gone then the ship is now difficult terrain (Vacuum).

glossary_clean.name: SHIP HANDLING
glossary_clean.desc: The handling of a ship indicates how maneuverable it is and how difficult is it to pilot. See HANDLING section under SPACE rules for details

glossary_clean.name: SHIP HULL
glossary_clean.desc: Hull is your ship's durability. Taking damage will lower this value. It can be repaired using resources but does not recover naturally. If your HULL reaches 0 your ship is SCRAPPED.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP INSTRUMENTS
glossary_clean.desc: The instrument rating on a ship indicates how precise it can navigate its electronic warfare capabilities. See INSTRUMENTS section under SPACE rules for details

glossary_clean.name: SHIP JUMP MAX RANGE
glossary_clean.desc: Indicates how many galactic quadrants your ship can calculate a trajectory to.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP JUMP SPEED
glossary_clean.desc: Indicates how fast you travel when at jump speed. Standard speed is a week (100 hrs) per quadrant.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP LIFE SUPPORT
glossary_clean.desc: This value lets you know how long your life support can handle a full load of passengers on board in optimal conditions. Having more people than life support will lead to death.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP MAX PASSENGERS
glossary_clean.desc: Indicates how many passengers this ship can carry. Crew and passengers count separately on a ship and will more than likely have different accommodations. Life support will also match the maximum passenger count.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP MAXIMUM CREW
glossary_clean.desc: The maximum crew is the amount of personal required to fully staff a ship. Anyone operating on a ship under maximum crew has a SMALL penalty to all their skill checks.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP MINIMUM CREW
glossary_clean.desc: The minimum amount of personnel required on a ship to operate it. Anyone operating on a ship under minimum crew has a LARGE penalty to all their skill checks.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP REPAIRS
glossary_clean.desc: When repairing a ship you need to have the available resource units and perform a skill check (TECHNOLOGY for SYSTEM or JOURNEYMAN for HULL) to restore one point. Shields do not require skill checks and can instead convert X resources units to shield see SHIP SHIELD RECHARGE.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP SCAN RANGE
glossary_clean.desc: This is how far away you can detect other ships and objects. Anything beyond that range is impossible to detect.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP SHIELD
glossary_clean.desc: Shields on spaceships function as damage buffer. Any damage done will impact shields first. If no shields are available then the damage goes directly into HULL or SYSTEM.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP SHIELD RECHARGE
glossary_clean.desc: Shield recharge on a spaceship indicates how many units of power you can send to the shield to recharge an equal amount.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP SPEED
glossary_clean.desc: The speed of ships is normalized to 3 distinct values: LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH. (you can always lower your speed). Ship speed has no effect on jump range. See SHIP speed section of SPACE rules for more details.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP STRUCTURE
glossary_clean.desc: Structure is the damage threshold that your HULL can take before you are COMPROMISED or CRIPPLED. Any hull damage exceeding this value in a single hit will cause one of those TRAUMA.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP SYSTEM
glossary_clean.desc: System is your ship's electronics' durability, taking system damage will lower this value. It can be repaired using resources but does not recover naturally. If your SYSTEM reaches 0 your ship is SCRAPPED.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP TYPE
glossary_clean.desc: The type of a ship determines which subclass the ship belongs to and will determine it's internal configurations, role and components.

glossary_clean.name: SHIP WARFARE
glossary_clean.desc: The warfare rating on a ship indicates how advanced the weapon systems are and how difficult they are to operate. See WARFARE section under SPACE rules for details.

glossary_clean.name: SICK
glossary_clean.desc: The sick ailment causes anyone to have a SMALL penalty to all ATTRIBUTES and DEFENSES. SICK cannot be removed through RECOVER, see the condition that applied SICK to find out how to remove it.

glossary_clean.name: SIZE
glossary_clean.desc: Indicate how big and bulky an item is

glossary_clean.name: SKILL CHECK
glossary_clean.desc: Roll a number of D10 equal to your skill rank, then add any bonus or penalty to the result. Compare result to the DC of the skill check

glossary_clean.name: SLEEP
glossary_clean.desc: Not sleeping will cause the SICK ailment if you go over 30 hours without rest. A 10 hour REST or a sleep replicator (COST 1 morale) will cure this ailment.

glossary_clean.name: SLOW
glossary_clean.desc: Maximum movement is 2, always lose initiative

glossary_clean.name: SMALL BONUS
glossary_clean.desc: Increase total successes of a roll by 1

glossary_clean.name: SMALL PENALTY
glossary_clean.desc: Decrease total successes of a roll by 1 (min 0)

glossary_clean.name: SOAK
glossary_clean.desc: SOAK is the ability of a forcefield or Armor to reduce the damage of an attack. If the damage is reduced to 0 the attack is considered fully absorbed and no other effects are checked.

glossary_clean.name: SPACE
glossary_clean.desc: Device is rated for space and provides up to 8 hours of life support as well as magnetic boots. Treat character as having GRAVITY TRAINING when walking on compatible surfaces.

glossary_clean.name: SPECIAL
glossary_clean.desc: Special is a section that lists any special property the armor, weapon, forcefield or device might have.

glossary_clean.name: STANDARD ATTACK
glossary_clean.desc: Normal attack, can be modified by various talents and circumstances.

glossary_clean.name: STEALTH
glossary_clean.desc: Device is designed for covert ops and provides a SMALL bonus to CONCEALMENT rolls.

glossary_clean.name: STRUCTURE
glossary_clean.desc: STRUCTURE is the damage threshold for DURABILITY TRAUMA.

glossary_clean.name: STUN DAMAGE
glossary_clean.desc: Stun damage is temporary unless you take more stun damage than you have DEADLY left, when that happens overwrite the existing stun damage into normal damage. Stun damage is healed at the end of a scene.

glossary_clean.name: STUNNED
glossary_clean.desc: While STUNNED you cannot act until you RECOVER from that ailment.

glossary_clean.name: SUFFOCATING
glossary_clean.desc: An absence of air will lead to suffocation. When a character is deprived of air roll a RESILIENCE check every round at DC1, increase DC by 1 for every round thereafter until death or a source of air is found. On a failed check you lose the DC of the resilience check as health (stun dmg). DMG will not sop if you enter DYING state.

glossary_clean.name: SUPPRESSED
glossary_clean.desc: While SUPPRESSED, any actions you perform first require a Willpower check (DC = shooters accuracy). On success you can act normally. On failure lose 1 morale and you are forced to use the next action to either move out of the cover fire area or move into better cover within the area. If either option is unavailable you must go PRONE on your location and cannot move.

glossary_clean.name: SYMBIOTE
glossary_clean.desc: REMOVED : Change to consumable item (armor in a bottle)

glossary_clean.name: SYSTEM
glossary_clean.desc: How many HACKS it takes to render this device innactive. Any devices with no SYSTEM stat goes down in 1 HACK. Devices with 0 SYSTEM can be repaired (takes 1 scene)

glossary_clean.name: TOOLS
glossary_clean.desc: Tools and options which help can provide a small or large bonus, some actions might require tools and instead of granting a bonus, tools will negate a penalty. GM's discretion.

glossary_clean.name: TOTAL COVER
glossary_clean.desc: Total cover means that the target is fully hidden from view. You cannot try to shoot around total cover but you can still shoot through; see BAD or GOOD cover for effects.

glossary_clean.name: TRANSPONDER
glossary_clean.desc: Your ship identification and classification to other ships that can scan you. Also contains your ship name. (Registration and ship name should match... but then there's pirates).

glossary_clean.name: TRAUMA
glossary_clean.desc: Trauma is a keyword to indicate that the subject is suffering from an effect caused by high HEALTH or MORALE loss. LIGHT TRAUMA are GRAVE and SHAKEN. SEVERE TRAUMA is MORTAL and BROKEN

glossary_clean.name: TURRET WEAPONS
glossary_clean.desc: Weapons labelled as turret weapons are gimballed and can face any direction they need. Weapons that are TURRET tagged can fire even when the GUNNER is at a DISADVANTAGE. As a drawback turret weapons use up more component space and use additional power.

glossary_clean.name: UNIVERSAL
glossary_clean.desc: Device can fit any of the alliance races, in the case of ARMOR, it can be put on or removed as a COMPLEX action

glossary_clean.name: VULNERABLE
glossary_clean.desc: Increase any damage taken (including ongoing damage) damage by the value of the vulnerability.

glossary_clean.name: WALL
glossary_clean.desc: How much defense against MORALE attacks your device grants.

glossary_clean.name: WOUND TRESHOLD
glossary_clean.desc: When you suffer health damage in excess of your  endurance, you gain the grave wound status ailment; if you were already suffering from a grave wound you replace it to a mortal wound status. If you were already suffering from a mortal wound you go strait to the DYING status.

glossary_clean.name: ZERO-G
glossary_clean.desc: A condition that occurs when a ship's Life Support loses power. Movement counts as Difficult Terrain for all crew members.

glossary_clean.name: JOB ORDER
glossary_clean.desc: The fixed sequence in which ship crew roles act during ship combat: MAINTENANCE → COMMANDER → ENGINEER → NAVIGATOR → PILOT → GUNNER. Advantage and Disadvantage from each role is passed to the next role in this order.

glossary_clean.name: FUSION DRIVE
glossary_clean.desc: The standard propulsion system used by most ships. Runs on effectively infinite fuel and requires no refueling under normal circumstances.

glossary_clean.name: COMMANDER (ROLE)
glossary_clean.desc: A ship crew role that uses LEADERSHIP vs the ship's Command rating. A successful roll lets the Commander add the Command rating as a bonus to any one other job this round. Failure causes Disadvantage on the chosen job; Critical Failure applies Disadvantage to all jobs.

glossary_clean.name: ENGINEER (ROLE)
glossary_clean.desc: A ship crew role that uses ENGINEERING vs the ship's Engineering rating. Generates Resource Units (RU) on success, which are spent to repair shields (no check), hull (CRAFT), or systems (TECHNOLOGY).

glossary_clean.name: NAVIGATOR (ROLE)
glossary_clean.desc: A ship crew role that uses NAVIGATION vs the ship's Instruments rating. Determines whether crew roles relying on targeting and sensors (HACKING, CYBERINTEL, OPERATOR, PILOT) gain Advantage or Disadvantage based on the instrument comparison with the enemy ship.

glossary_clean.name: PILOT (ROLE)
glossary_clean.desc: A ship crew role that uses PILOTING vs the ship's Handling rating. Determines whether Gunners gain Advantage or Disadvantage based on the handling comparison with the enemy ship.

glossary_clean.name: GUNNER (ROLE)
glossary_clean.desc: A ship crew role that uses HEAVY WEAPONS vs the ship's Warfare rating. Determines hit, miss, or Critical Hit based on the warfare comparison with the enemy ship. Fixed Weapons cannot fire under Disadvantage; Turret Weapons still fire with a penalty.
